ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 9:1 ratio of high-intensity light-gray/white pixels (ventral surface) to low-intensity black pixels (trailing edge and focal spots).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous low-intensity black band along the entire superior trailing edge. Focal dark circular blobs are mapped at: center-left lobe (mid-depth), lower-left lobe (small cluster), and center-right lobe (mid-depth).

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a sharp vertex angle approximately measuring 45 degrees relative to the lobe intersection.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular sawtooth serrations observed along the entire trailing edge boundary, with greater pixel-amplitude peaks on the distal half of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave curve fitted from the median notch vertex extending upward toward the distal tips of both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast dark circular pixel clusters on the mid-left and mid-right fluke quadrants; no high-intensity white rosette clusters visible on the dark margins.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Two distinct low-intensity circular marks or voids located at the extreme terminal tip of the left fluke lobe.
